title: Poll: what causes most of your revision rounds?
caption:
What causes most of your revision rounds?
I'm keeping a tally this month, and I'd like to compare notes.

Every time a video goes back for another round, I write one line on why. If I know where rounds come from, I can fix the cause before the next brief goes out.

My early guess is that most rounds trace back to the first call. Something nobody asked about then comes up in round two.

I might be wrong, and it probably differs between brands and agencies.

Vote for the one that costs your team the most. If it's something else, put it in the comments.

I'll share what the tally shows once the month is done.

Follow Galvor for more from the brief-to-live desk.

poll.question: What causes most of your revision rounds?

first_comment: My one-line format for the tally: date, video, round number, cause. That's all it takes to see a pattern.
